description: Homebrew Formula Submission: discover, prepare, submit, and evidence Homebrew tap/core publication for nwau-py.
blocker: Personal Homebrew tap is published and verified with audit, source install, and brew test passing; Homebrew/core publication still requires upstream PR/review.

preparation_evidence.discovery: brew info nwau-py --json=v2 returned `No available formula with the name nwau-py`.
preparation_evidence.fixedLocalBlocker: Added Language::Python::Virtualenv include, exact PyPI source URL, sdist sha256, explicit python@3.13 dependency, Click PyPI resource, and a temporary lazy CLI import patch for the published 0.2.2 sdist.
preparation_evidence.auditResult: brew audit --strict --online edithatogo/mchs/nwau-py passed after adding the Click resource and lazy CLI inreplace patch.
preparation_evidence.fixedFutureReleaseBlocker: Changed the local CLI so root --help no longer eagerly imports pandas, numpy, pydantic, or pyreadstat; the tap carries an equivalent temporary inreplace patch until a new PyPI release includes the fix.
preparation_evidence.remainingExternalBlocker: Homebrew/core publication requires upstream PR/review; the personal tap formula is verified.
preparation_evidence.installTestResult: brew install --build-from-source edithatogo/mchs/nwau-py and brew test edithatogo/mchs/nwau-py passed.
